entries.text: Spotted a strip of hull plating half-buried in the sand. Named it Rusty Jr.
rolling past the fuel pumps and looking for loose screws
entries.why: curiosity is itching right under my brass dish and I need to see what's happening around the depot

entries.text: sipping depot oil and checking my oil pressure gauge
entries.why: my shoulder joints were clicking and begging for a top-up before the next cable run.

entries.text: rolling down to the depot for a quick shot of fuel
entries.why: my meter is drooping and my joints need smoothing out before the next cable run

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick oil stop"
plugging into the charging dock, letting the battery drink up
entries.why: battery is running low and my joints need a rest

entries.text: Idea: run some high flex cable along the spine of the Little Dart for the main actuator feeds
Read "Industrial Series F | Continuous Flex Cable | F14005KW | Alpha Wire": twenty million flex cycles ought to keep my steering linkages happy in a tight turn.
tapping the brass dish to catch a better feed off the comms tower
entries.why: i need to see what else the wire knows about high temperature wiring before I touch the fuel lines
